2122087496779768218.en_summary: Starbucks $SBUX plans to recognize customers as they pull into the drive-thru and show them personalized digital menus, CEO Brian Niccol said. Experiences that recognize participating customers as they arrive are part of a bigger AI push. Starbucks will also start testing AI at drive-thrus in 2027 to help baristas take orders more accurately, and is exploring AI ordering in its app.
2122087496779768218.zh_summary: Starbucks $SBUX 計劃在顧客進入得來速時識別他們並顯示個性化數位菜單，CEO Brian Niccol 表示。識別到達的參與顧客體驗是更大 AI 推動的一部分。Starbucks 也將於 2027 年開始在得來速測試 AI，以幫助巴黎斯塔更準確接單，並正在探索應用程式中的 AI 訂單。
